summary.en: Render the Mobile application on Android System WebView 83 while preserving cryptographic identifiers and visible startup failures.
summary.zh: 让移动应用可在 Android System WebView 83 上渲染，同时保留密码学标识符与可见的启动错误。

compatibilityExceptions.reason: The repository lockfile, build-script policy, third-party notice, and host aggregate changes only register the Mobile-owned core-js dependency and UUID helper; Desktop imports no new module and its runtime behavior is unchanged.

The repository lockfile, build-script policy, third-party notice, and host aggregate changes only register the Mobile-owned core-js dependency and UUID helper; no Platform entry, route, deployment input, or runtime behavior changes.
